How it works

Your move
in four acts.

Act 1

You tell us about your move.

From, to, dates, type of home: a few minutes are enough. An adviser reviews volume and access, and arranges a visit when useful.

  • Free, no-obligation quote
  • Home or video survey
Act 2

We protect what matters.

Boxes, bubble wrap, mattress covers, protection for TVs, mirrors and artwork, wardrobe boxes for hanging clothes.

  • Fragile packing depending on package
  • Packing materials supplied
Act 3

We load, we drive.

Furniture dismantling, handling and transport in padded vehicles matched to your volume. A furniture lift is arranged if the stairs are not enough.

  • Padded vehicles
  • Furniture lift if needed
Act 4

You are home.

Furniture reassembled and placed, unpacking depending on your package. The team checks everything with you before leaving.

  • Reassembly and placement
  • Unpacking depending on package

Your belongings protected

The declaration of value,
made simple.

Before the move, you complete a declaration of value: you state the total value of your belongings and list valuable items separately. It sets the maximum compensation in case of damage.

  • Your CODEM adviser helps you complete it
  • Remember paintings, jewellery, instruments and antiques
  • It is attached to the moving contract
